pay.test_mode.description: Notice at the top of the PAY.JP checkout and card pages while the server uses PAY.JP's test keys: no card is charged.

pay.fake_notice.defaultMessage: Test build: this page stands in for a payment provider, and no money moves.
pay.fake_notice.description: Notice at the top of the checkout and portal pages of the fake payment provider, which only test builds have (ADR-0015 §6).

pay.back.description: Link from a payment page back to the screen of this server the user came from.

pay.card.email.description: Label of the email address field of the card form on the PAY.JP checkout and card pages, which the card's 3-D Secure needs.

pay.card.name.description: Label of the card holder's name field of the card form on the PAY.JP checkout and card pages.

pay.card.name_hint.defaultMessage: As printed on the card, in Latin letters.
pay.card.name_hint.description: Hint above the card holder's name field of the card form on the PAY.JP checkout and card pages.

pay.card.label.description: Label of PAY.JP's card element (number, expiry, security code, in PAY.JP's own frame) on the checkout and card pages.

pay.card.note.defaultMessage: The card details go into PAY.JP's form and never reach this server.
pay.card.note.description: Note under PAY.JP's card element on the checkout and card pages.

pay.card.failed.defaultMessage: The card could not be checked, and nothing was charged. Check the email address, the name on the card, and the card details, then try again.
pay.card.failed.description: Alert of the card form when PAY.JP could not take the card and gave no reason of its own.

pay.card.unavailable.defaultMessage: The card form could not be loaded. Reload the page, or try again in a while.
pay.card.unavailable.description: Alert of the card form when PAY.JP's script (payjp.js) could not be loaded, so no card can be entered.

pay.card.name_invalid.defaultMessage: Enter the name in Latin letters, as printed on the card.
pay.card.name_invalid.description: Error under the card holder's name field when it is not 2 to 45 Latin letters, digits, spaces, periods or hyphens, the only names PAY.JP takes. Shown before the card is sent.

pay.checkout.submit.description: Button of the PAY.JP checkout page that verifies the card (3-D Secure), pays the first period and starts the subscription. {amount} is what is charged now, formatted with its currency (¥1,200).

pay.checkout.then.description: Line right above the button of the PAY.JP checkout page: what the subscription costs after the first payment. {price} is a price with its interval (pay.price.month or pay.price.year).

pay.fake.pay.description: Button of the fake provider's checkout page that records the payment as paid.

pay.fake.fail.description: Button of the fake provider's checkout page that makes the payment fail, to test the failure.

pay.fake.cancel.description: Button of the fake provider's checkout page that goes back without paying.

pay.fake.portal.defaultMessage: This test build has no payment methods or invoices to manage.
pay.fake.portal.description: Text of the fake provider's portal page.

pay.portal.card.description: Heading of the card in use on the PAY.JP card page (the customer portal).

pay.portal.no_card.description: Text of the PAY.JP card page without a card.

pay.portal.change_card.description: Heading and button of the card change form on the PAY.JP card page.

pay.portal.history.description: Heading of the recent payments on the PAY.JP card page.

pay.portal.history_empty.description: Text of the PAY.JP card page without payments.

pay.portal.paused.defaultMessage: The last payment failed, so the subscription is paused, and its benefits end when the grace period does. Changing the card pays and resumes it.
pay.portal.paused.description: Alert of the PAY.JP card page while a subscription is paused after a failed payment.

pay.portal.plan.description: The subscription at the top of the PAY.JP card page. {plan} is the plan's name, {price} a price with its interval (pay.price.month or pay.price.year).

pay.portal.next.description: Line under the subscription at the top of the PAY.JP card page. {date} is the date of the next payment (YYYY-MM-DD).

pay.portal.add_card.description: Heading and button of the card form on the PAY.JP card page of a customer without a card.

pay.portal.refunded.description: The muted end of a row of the recent payments on the PAY.JP card page, for a payment refunded in part or in full. {amount} is formatted with its currency.

pay.price.month.description: A price paid every month on the payment pages. {amount} is formatted with its currency (¥1,200).

pay.price.year.description: A price paid every year on the payment pages. {amount} is formatted with its currency (¥12,000).

pay.price.once.description: An amount paid once (a tip) on the payment pages. {amount} is formatted with its currency (¥500).

pay.back_to_app.description: Action of a payment page that leads back to this server's app: under the error of an expired or unknown page, and at the end of the other pages.
